title: Mattermost and Pexip Modernise Video Conferencing for Mission-Critical Command and Control in Air-Gapped and DDIL Environments
summary: Defence and security teams brief, decide, and respond faster, with real-time agents, video, and workflow working together on infrastructure they own.
body_markdown:
*Defence and security teams brief, decide, and respond faster, with real-time agents, video, and workflow working together on infrastructure they own.*


**Berlin, Germany and Oslo, Norway, 17 November 2026** —[Mattermost](https://mattermost.com/) , the leading human-machine teaming platform for national security and critical infrastructure, and[Pexip](https://www.pexip.com/) , provider of secure, customizable video collaboration for defence and government organizations, today announced a strategic partnership and mutual resale agreement that combines Pexip’s self-hosted video conferencing platform with Mattermost’s Sovereign Agentic Solutions.


Defence ministries, armed forces, and security agencies can now modernise the full mission cycle, from briefing to incident response to after-action review, into an integrated workspace, with a purpose-built suite of Zero Trust agents and collaboration tools deployed to private and air-gapped networks and across denied, disrupted, intermittent, and limited (DDIL) environments, with no kill switch and no data exfiltration.


*Mattermost with Pexip: teams work securely and seamlessly with mission partners across agents, systems, messaging, and video on an integrated, self-hosted Zero Trust suite they fully control.*


“The multi-tenant cloud has given the world a decade of innovation and scale, and defence organisations want all of it and more. Mattermost and Pexip bring those capabilities into the world's most demanding environments, across air-gapped, classified and DDIL networks,” said Jason Blais, VP Product and NATO Alliances at Mattermost. “Command teams get ease and flexibility in a suite of video, messaging and collaboration tools, with the Zero Trust assurances and sovereign agentic workflows essential to modern military operations.”


“When decisions need to be made under pressure, defence teams need to communicate without switching between systems or compromising security,” said Arild Skiri, VP Defence at Pexip. “Together with Mattermost, we're bringing secure video directly into mission-critical workflows, on the networks commanders choose and control. Pexip has become synonymous with making video work across national systems, legacy meeting rooms and cloud platforms, while giving defence customers the freedom to run meetings on their own infrastructure. This partnership builds on that leadership, bringing secure video even closer to where critical decisions are made.”


**What the joint solution delivers**


- **The mission keeps running when the network does not.** Teams keep planning, briefing, and deciding in air-gapped and DDIL environments, on infrastructure they own, so continuity of command does not depend on any supplier or connection.
- **Faster decisions across commands and allies.** Brief coalition partners on video against a fused operational picture, with each operator seeing only what it is authorised to receive and every decision on the record.
- **Fewer errors, quicker response.** Responders, allied partners, and agents work in an integrated real-time collaboration workspace with playbooks and tasks attached, so teams accelerate workflows, reduce errors, and make faster decisions.
- **An operational system of record that improves the next mission.** Agents turn each meeting into an after-action review and an updated standard operating procedure, so lessons are applied once and every unit runs the next operation against it.


The joint capability is available today. Arrange a briefing or demonstration with either company ([Mattermost](https://mattermost.com/contact-sales/) ,[Pexip](https://www.pexip.com/contact) ).


**About Mattermost**


Mattermost is the leading human-machine teaming platform for national security and critical infrastructure. Through Sovereign Agentic Solutions, Mattermost puts mission-critical work in motion with secure collaboration and agentic workflows built for complex environments. Trusted by governments, allied militaries, and enterprises around the world, the platform runs self-hosted, in private and national clouds, on air-gapped classified networks, and at the tactical edge. It delivers secure messaging, file sharing, systems integration, workflow automation, audio and screen sharing, and project management, so customers own the data, the model, and the keys. For more information, visit[mattermost.com](https://mattermost.com/) .


**About Pexip**


Pexip provides seamless video communication to all organizations regardless of technology platforms and security requirements. Enterprise and government organizations worldwide rely on Pexip to control where their video meetings run, where their data stays, and who can participate. From everyday business meetings to classified defense collaboration, virtual care, and legal proceedings, Pexip enables secure communication in the world’s most demanding environments.


Founded in 2012, Pexip (PEXIP) is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange. Learn more at[pexip.com](https://www.pexip.com/) or follow Pexip on LinkedIn.
